scope: Validate new chat settings against engine bounds; retain old conversations and make acceptance settings readable and operable in both themes and narrow windows.

configuration.result: Fourteen new regressions failed while 68 existing tests passed. Invalid settings were accepted before local save/start.

layout.result: Both themes reproduced 50 pixels of horizontal overflow with long saved criteria in a narrow native window.

initial_focused.result: Types, lint, 109 unit tests and Electron/renderer builds passed. Two new native checks failed because their AxeBuilder call omitted the existing Electron setLegacyMode. The harness was corrected; no application pass is claimed for that native attempt.

implementation: Validate workspace paths, serialized expected-value byte limits, four distinct files/eight criteria, model UTF-8 bytes and simple connector/executable identifiers before saving defaults or creating/provisioning new work.
Keep persisted chat/default schemas readable so stricter start rules do not erase old transcripts or prevent correcting saved defaults.
Preserve invalid drafts with inline accessible feedback. Use path-first saved rows, readable check names, wrapping detail text and stable neutral Remove controls.

verification.checks: Root/E2E types, lint, Electron and renderer builds; two native theme flows without retries, including Axe checks, corrected criterion save/start, narrow-window overflow prevention and keyboard removal.

source_guard.qualification: Manual source hashes compared before/after verification; not an immutable queue snapshot.

verification.full_validation: Pending exact-head CI after normal-hook commit and push; prior-commit CI does not qualify this change.

engine_contract.method: Bundled production parser and the exact copied Rust engine validator evaluated the same wire bodies, including captured corrected native requests, multibyte boundaries and JSON escaping.
